meta.title: Where Is Pip?
meta.textType: story: a search through every room, with questions and answers

paragraphs: "Pip! Where are you?" calls Tom. It is morning in the house. Tom and his sister, Lily, can't find Pip. His favorite red ball is not in his bed. "Is he in the kitchen?" asks Lily. She looks under the table. "No, he isn't." Her brother looks in the bathroom. He looks behind the door. No Pip.

"Is he in the bedroom?" asks Tom. Lily looks under her bed. Then she looks between the two chairs. "Is he next to the lamp?" asks Tom. "No, he isn't!" says Lily. The big clock is on the wall. Tom looks at the clock. "Where is Pip?" asks Lily. Lily is sad. "Mom! Can you find Pip?" asks Tom.

Mom goes to the living room. "Look!" says Mom. "Behind the big brown sofa!" Pip is there. He sleeps with his red ball. Tom puts the ball in front of the sofa. Pip opens his eyes. "Woof!" says Pip. "Good dog!" says Lily. Pip is happy. Tom and Lily are happy too.
text.summary: Tom and Lily cannot find Pip in the house. They look in every room, and Mom finds him behind the sofa.
